接口 Runnable

  • 所有已知子接口:
    RunnableFuture<V>, RunnableScheduledFuture<V>, Task
    所有已知实现类:
    AccumulativeRunnable, AppletPanel, AsyncBoxView.ChildState, AsynchInvoke, AsyncInvoker, AsyncResponseImpl, AudioPlayer, AWTAutoShutdown, CommunicatorServer, CompilerThread, Connection, CountedTimerTask, D3DScreenUpdateManager, DataPusher, Disposer, EventHandler, EventThread, Fiber, ForkJoinWorkerThread, FutureTask, GraphicsPrimitive.TraceReporter, HttpReader, InnocuousThread, InternalEventHandler, KeepAliveCache, NameServiceStartThread, NetworkServer, PoolCleaner, PrintJob2D, ProcessMonitorThread, QueryListener, RenderableImageProducer, RequestProcessor, SnmpAdaptorServer, SoftAudioPusher, SwingWorker, TargetVM, Thread, ThreadDialog, TimerTask, Worker, WToolkit
    函数接口:
    这是一个函数接口, 因此可用作 lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。

    @FunctionalInterface
public interface Runnable
    The Runnable interface should be implemented by any class whose instances are intended to be executed by a thread. The class must define a method of no arguments called run.

    This interface is designed to provide a common protocol for objects that wish to execute code while they are active. For example, Runnable is implemented by class Thread. Being active simply means that a thread has been started and has not yet been stopped.

    In addition, Runnable provides the means for a class to be active while not subclassing Thread. A class that implements Runnable can run without subclassing Thread by instantiating a Thread instance and passing itself in as the target. In most cases, the Runnable interface should be used if you are only planning to override the run() method and no other Thread methods. This is important because classes should not be subclassed unless the programmer intends on modifying or enhancing the fundamental behavior of the class.

    从以下版本开始:

    Arthur van Hoff

      void run()
      When an object implementing interface Runnable is used to create a thread, starting the thread causes the object's run method to be called in that separately executing thread.

    • 方法详细资料

      • run

        void run()
        When an object implementing interface Runnable is used to create a thread, starting the thread causes the object's run method to be called in that separately executing thread.

        The general contract of the method run is that it may take any action whatsoever.

        另请参阅:
        Thread.run()
